title: Croatian Burger Buns
description: A unique twist on traditional burger buns, inspired by Croatian cuisine. These soft and airy buns are perfect for adding an Indian touch to your burgers.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add the warm water and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Add the aerated and mix until the dough is light and airy.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4-6 equal portions, depending on the desired size of the buns.
Shape each portion into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Place the buns onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the buns for 15-20 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
Let the buns cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes before serving.
